title: Allgemeinverfügung zum 1. Mai 2026 – Einschränkungen im Bereich Treptower Park

extraction.summaryEn: Police issued a general order restricting assemblies in Treptower Park from 1 May 2026, 6:00, to 2 May 2026, 6:00. The order covers the area between the Spree, Bulgarische Straße, Am Treptower Park and the S-Bahn line.
